about.title: About Kvell Tax & Accounting
text: We are a Houston-based tax and accounting consulting firm. We provide tax and accounting consulting services to small and medium-size businesses and individuals.

Two of our core members, who also happen to be great friends, have years of experience working in the Big 4 public accounting firms. After spending years working in the trenches, they decided to put together their knowledge and experience and start their own tax & accounting consulting services. Since the inception, there has been no looking back.

We provide our consulting services to US residents as well as expatriates (US citizens temporarily living in other countries). We also help foreign residents who are planning to come settle in the USA – as individuals as well as businesses. Having multiple French and Italian speaking CPAs is definitely a big advantage both for our clients and for us.
